newsitem.title: USA: Manhattan Bagel inks deal with franchisor.
newsitem.headline: Manhattan Bagel inks deal with franchisor.

text.p: Manhattan Bagel Co Inc said Tuesday that it has signed a letter of intent with Doctors' Associates Inc, franchisor of the Subway chain, for it to invest $14.7 million in the company through the purchase of a five-year convertible note.

The company said that under the proposed deal, it would gain the right to sell bagels and cheese spreads to participating franchisees in the 12,800-unit Subway chain if the franchisor implements a bagel program.

Under terms of the letter of intent, the note carries a 6.25 percent interest rate and is convertible into shares of Manhattan Bagel common stock at $5.875 per share, or initially 2.5 million shares, at the option of DAI at any time, or at the option of Manhattan Bagel under certain conditions.
The proposed transactions said the company, are subject to the execution of definitive agreements, due diligence reviews by both parties, and other customary conditions.
Manhattan Bagel franchises, licenses or operates over 340 stores in 19 states, Washington, D.C. and Canada.
